title: #319 External Appearance
prompt: One should never judge a person by external appearances. To what extent do you agree with this statement?

promptSegments.text: One should never judge a person by external appearances.
To what extent do you agree with this statement?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Judging people by their looks is wrong because a person has many parts to them.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Judging people by their looks is wrong because a person has many parts to them.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: A person's actions are better proof of who they are than their looks.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A person's actions are better proof of who they are than their looks.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: A person's looks are not the only thing that matters.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A person's looks are not the only thing that matters.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: A person's actions are more important than their looks.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A person's actions are more important than their looks.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: True character is defined by inner qualities, which are more significant than physical appearance, as someone who looks well might still be unkind.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: True character is defined by inner qualities, which are more significant than physical appearance, as someone who looks well might still be unkind.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: A person's true worth is revealed through their actions and personality, such as a quiet student who helps others without seeking recognition.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A person's true worth is revealed through their actions and personality, such as a quiet student who helps others without seeking recognition.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: A person's character and actions are more important than their physical appearance, as someone plain can be very kind and helpful.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A person's character and actions are more important than their physical appearance, as someone plain can be very kind and helpful.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Judging people based on looks is inaccurate because inner qualities are harder to see than outer ones, potentially causing us to miss good people.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Judging people based on looks is inaccurate because inner qualities are harder to see than outer ones, potentially causing us to miss good people.

modelPlan.focus: Discuss the importance of not judging people based on their appearance and the value of understanding their intrinsic qualities.
keyArguments: Judging by appearance can lead to superficial conclusions and missed opportunities for genuine connection.
Focusing on intrinsic qualities fosters empathy, deeper understanding, and more meaningful relationships.
